description:

Once you're logged in, choose the website you want to edit from your dashboard.

The best in all is using the Acuity scheduling as shown here.

This is the built-in, fully integrated scheduling tool from Squarespace.

In the main dashboard, go to Settings, then choose Scheduling.

If you haven’t set it up before, you’ll be prompted to link or create a Scheduling account.

After setting up your availability, appointment types, and payment settings, you can display your scheduler on your site.

This is the appointment scheduling page looks like, you can also create new page, you can go with

Go to Pages and click + Add Page, then choose Scheduling to create a standalone booking page.

Alternatively, go to any page and click Edit, then choose + Add Block and select the Scheduling block to embed your calendar directly.

You can then add this link in menu on the website by editing it.

The option is to Use a Third-Party Tool like Calendly, to do this, go their website and get Inline Embed or your preferred format. and put it in code section in the website, we don't recommend this way, as its compliated.

Final Ste:
Whether you used Squarespace Scheduling or a third-party embed, preview your changes and make sure the scheduling tool is visible and working. Once confirmed, click Save to publish the feature to your live site.

And that’s it — you’ve successfully added appointment scheduling to your Squarespace website. Now your visitors can easily book time with you, and you can manage your availability all in one place.

Thanks for watching, and happy scheduling!

title: How to Add Pop up on Squarespace, Promotional or Email Popup Guide 2026
description:
In today’s video, I’m going to show you How to Add Pop up on Squarespace, Promotional or Email Popup Guide 2026, perfect for grabbing attention, announcing offers, or encouraging visitors to join your email list.

Squarespace makes it simple to set up a promotional popup in under 5 minutes. Whether you want to display a discount banner, newsletter signup, or a special message, this guide will walk you through it step by step.

Start by visiting the Squarespace homepage, and log in by clicking the Login button in the top-right corner. For quick access, choose Continue with Google and select the account connected to your Squarespace site.

Once logged in, you’ll land in your dashboard. Click on your website to enter its backend management area.

Now look at the left-hand menu and go to Pages. While we’re not editing a page today, this is your entry point to more settings. Scroll to the Website Tools section and click on Promotional Popup — the feature we’ll be working with.

Here’s how to enable pop up on Squarespace:
You’ll see a toggle switch to turn your popup on. Flip it to activate the popup, and then click Save at the top-left to make sure your changes are applied.

Next, click Change Layout to explore various popup layout options in Squarespace. Select the one that suits your website’s style and purpose.

Once you’ve picked a layout, move on to the content editor. This is where you customize your popup message, add an email field for newsletter signups, or drop in a call-to-action. Whether you're creating an email list join popup or showcasing a new launch, this is your space to be creative.

Make sure to use clear language, bold fonts, and a compelling offer. This is key for an effective Squarespace email capture popup.

Finally, hit Save again once you’re happy with your design and content. Your Squarespace popup is now live and ready to engage visitors.

And that’s how to create a newsletter signup popup in Squarespace or use it for any message you’d like to highlight.

Use popups wisely — a well-timed message can drive conversions, but too many can turn users away.

Thanks for watching this Squarespace popup settings tutorial. Like and subscribe for more simple steps to elevate your website.
